rationale: Five evaluated points span 156.32-157.59us with identical 34.603MB simulator DRAM traffic regardless of block_M, stages, or swizzle, so the serpentine reuse hypothesis remains unconfirmed and traffic keeps weight 1 but no reward. Attempt-04 (block_M=32, block_N=128, block_K=64, stages=1, swizzle=16) is the new best at 156.32us with only 20480B smem and 4 blocks/SM, showing lower smem footprint (via block_M=32 and stages=1) and higher occupancy correlate with the small gain; footprint weight is therefore cut to 0.25 so it does not penalize low-smem candidates. Pipeline stays at 1 since stages=1 has now produced both the previous and current best. Domains remain broad because only five tuples are excluded and the 32768-byte portability cap still admits many combos (tightest BM=128,BN=128,BK=64,stages=2). Next hypothesis: probe block_M=32/64 with block_N=128, block_K=64 or 32, stages 1-2, across all swizzle values to see whether the low-smem/high-occupancy direction breaks the ~156us plateau or whether the tall-skinny M=128 shape is saturated. Proxy cost is a dimensionless ranking only, never microseconds; Metal checks execute exact source/config/TIR but not the CUDA binary, GB10 values are simulator estimates not hardware measurements, and no global optimality is claimed.
